original_replay.method: First actual Qv unlimited scalar-advection call in step1, replay on identical full-domain FP32 inputs against existing float64 mirrors for order3 and requested order5. Original production launcher kwargs preserved; explicit5 only writes an independent output buffer. Requested order5 is read from this sealed case authority. Capture stops before completing the first timestep.

stage1_coupled_to_qv_error_estimate.method: Only advection-tendency difference, projected through the first RK stage dt=15/3 and map/dry-mass update; all other inputs and source increments held equal. This is not a completed timestep or forecast.

fixed_first_call.method: First actual Qv unlimited scalar-advection call in step1, replay on identical full-domain FP32 inputs against existing float64 mirrors for order3 and requested order5. Original production launcher kwargs preserved; explicit5 only writes an independent output buffer. Requested order5 is read from this sealed case authority. Capture stops before completing the first timestep.

bounded_order_verification.method: Identical full-domain captured step1 inputs, existing float64 unlimited/PD flux and donor-budget renormalization mirrors; order3/5, specified map-weighted geometry. Signed SL controls replace only rw on interior eta faces with prescribed |Courant|>1; they are branch controls, not physically integrated forecasts. Bounds scale from FP32 epsilon and the parent flux/tendency magnitude.

operator_stop_rule: Stop after confirmed scalar-advection selector defect; no new diffusion/Noah replays after finding it.

full_forecast.noise_floor_caveat: One positive uniform theta perturbation on the original defective build, not a statistical sensitivity distribution or a corrected-build noise floor.
